gloss: a fixed amount; a set amount of money

definitions.gloss: a fixed amount of money; a set sum
definitions.explanation: A predetermined, set sum of money — for example, a fixed monthly allowance, a flat fee, a fixed deductible, or a threshold below which special rules apply. {一定額|いっていがく} appears constantly in financial, legal, tax, and contractual writing where a numeric amount is held constant or compared against a threshold.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{一定額|いっていがく}を{貯金|ちょきん}している。
examples.english: I save a fixed amount every month.

examples.japanese: {一定額|いっていがく}{以上|いじょう}の{支出|ししゅつ}には{上司|じょうし}の{承認|しょうにん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Expenditures above a fixed amount require the approval of a superior.

examples.japanese: この{制度|せいど}では、{所得|しょとく}が{一定額|いっていがく}を{超|こ}えると{支援|しえん}の{対象|たいしょう}から{外|はず}れる。
examples.english: Under this system, you fall outside the scope of support if your income exceeds a fixed amount.

examples.japanese: {老後|ろうご}の{備|そな}えとして、{給料|きゅうりょう}から{自動的|じどうてき}に{一定額|いっていがく}を{投資信託|とうししんたく}に{回|まわ}している。
examples.english: As preparation for old age, I automatically channel a fixed amount from my salary into mutual funds.

notes:
{一定額|いっていがく} is a standard administrative and financial term meaning "a fixed amount" of money.

FORMS:
- {一定|いってい} ("fixed, set, constant") + {額|がく} (from {金額|きんがく} "amount of money") → {一定額|いっていがく}

USAGE:
- Personal finance and saving plans ({一定額|いっていがく}を{貯金|ちょきん}する "to save a fixed amount")
- Tax and welfare thresholds ({一定額|いっていがく}{以上|いじょう}の{所得|しょとく} "income above a certain amount")
- Insurance deductibles, copay caps, and grant limits
- Corporate expense-approval rules
- Government subsidies and benefit programs
- {一定額|いっていがく}{以上|いじょう} is an extremely common phrase in administrative and policy writing, equivalent to "a certain (specified) amount or more" in English.
- For consumer subscription pricing ("flat rate"), {定額|ていがく}{制|せい} is the standard label, not {一定額|いっていがく}{制|せい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一定額|いっていがく}{以上|いじょう}: a fixed amount or more (a threshold above which something applies)
- {一定額|いっていがく}{以下|いか}: a fixed amount or less (a threshold below which something applies)
- {一定額|いっていがく}を{超|こ}える: to exceed a fixed amount
- {一定額|いっていがく}に{達|たっ}する: to reach a fixed amount
- {毎月|まいつき}{一定額|いっていがく}: a fixed amount each month
- {一定額|いっていがく}まで: up to a fixed amount

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {一定|いってい}: fixed, set, constant — the broader adjective; modifies many nouns ({一定|いってい}の{条件|じょうけん} "certain conditions")
- {定額|ていがく}: fixed amount, flat rate — closely related and often interchangeable; {定額|ていがく}{制|せい} "flat-rate plan" is a common service category. {定額|ていがく} feels more set-in-advance / contractual; {一定額|いっていがく} more often functions as "a (single) certain amount" used as a threshold.
- {限度額|げんどがく}: maximum amount, ceiling
- {上限|じょうげん} / {下限|かげん}: upper / lower limit
- {金額|きんがく}: monetary amount (general)
